title: Is Your Toxicity My Toxicity? Exploring the Impact of Rater Identity on Toxicity Annotation
benchmark_measurement: Bias analysis (using the BPSN metric) for toxicity detection models, specifically evaluating performance on comments containing the identity term 'muslim'.
findings: Models trained on data annotated by specialized rater pools (African American and LGBTQ) showed improved BPSN bias performance for the identity term 'muslim' compared to a model trained on data from a control rater pool.
